description: Year-by-year funding totals for a topic. Returns annual grant funding amounts for grants matching the query over the specified year range.

currency.description: Currency for funding amounts (default USD). Supported: AUD, CAD, CHF, CNY, EUR, GBP, JPY, NZD, USD.

endYear.description: Last year of the time range (inclusive)

query.description: Search query to identify grants (e.g., 'cancer immunotherapy')

startYear.description: First year of the time range (inclusive)

name: funding_trend
title: Funding trend
